sourceObservation.finding: At 09:54:19 UTC on 2026-11-15, one of seven colleague messages in the inspected thread is a thread_broadcast; six ordinary colleague ingress entries and six assistant replies are present. The broadcast appears between two of those ordinary exchanges. Its event transport envelope was not captured.
sourceObservation.history: Live subtype exclusion is already present at the earliest repository revision, 84d399cf45b8ee47d64e8f281020164562c353e2 (2026-04-16, initial v1.7.0 import), src/connectors/slack/app.ts. No earlier introduction is provable. 5.4.3 and 5.4.4 behavior reproduced.
sourceObservation.limitation: The preserved history object is real. Slack socket delivery, authorization metadata, external APIs, model behavior and downstream booking are mocked. No live replay or send.

evidence.separateObservation: Ordinary colleague mid-thread channel mention recovery has an existing difference from the live owner-presence rule (background.ts vs handlers.ts). No production incident or separate admission. Scope retains the ordinary recovery behavior.
